- linux/amd64

- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10

- '3.11'

about.description:
RIVOLI reconstructs continuous BRDFs from sparse measurements. It fits expansions
on radial basis functions over the product of the hemispheres of the half and
difference vectors, optionally times an interval of wavelengths, regularized by
their Dirichlet energy. The models are reciprocal by construction, can be
evaluated anywhere, on a GPU with NVIDIA Warp, and written as MERL files.

name: rivoli
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.1"
  python_min: "3.13"

package:
  name: rivoli
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/r/rivoli/rivoli-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7838dddb3d5a50e3dd8c0f02bfe309d55007efdb192526cbf0b25f1d156cbba7

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - setuptools-scm >=8
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=2.2
  run_constraints:
    # Optional dependencies, the extras of the package on PyPI: not installed with
    # rivoli, but constrained when they are
    - warp-lang >=1.7
    - h5py >=3.12

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - rivoli
        - rivoli.model
        - rivoli.merl
        - rivoli.sampling
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/fmargall/rivoli
  summary: Reconstruction of BRDFs from sparse measurements by radial basis functions.
  description: |
    RIVOLI reconstructs continuous BRDFs from sparse measurements. It fits expansions
    on radial basis functions over the product of the hemispheres of the half and
    difference vectors, optionally times an interval of wavelengths, regularized by
    their Dirichlet energy. The models are reciprocal by construction, can be
    evaluated anywhere, on a GPU with NVIDIA Warp, and written as MERL files.
  # The tables of the CIE in rivoli/data are distributed under CC-BY-SA-4.0, as
  # stated by the README next to them
  license: AGPL-3.0-or-later AND CC-BY-SA-4.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - src/rivoli/data/README.md
  repository: https://github.com/fmargall/rivoli

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - fmargall
